verdict.rationale: Codex's own README states it can be used with an API key instead of ChatGPT sign-in, but describes this only as an alternative that 'requires additional setup'. ChatGPT login is the recommended path, and the setup steps are not documented in the pack. A community report also notes the newest Codex model was not yet available via the API, which limits the API-key path. Missing for 10: documented API-key setup steps (env var or login flag), confirmation of feature parity with account login, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: You can also use Codex with an API key, but this requires additional setup.
